description: FOUND s457ai while closing #817: lib/experimental.pm existed ONLY because `for values %h` did not alias (the real module does `$_ = version->new($_) for values %min_version`).  #817 fixed that, so the shim was moved aside and the real perl 5.40.3 experimental.pm was measured under PCL: it now gets PAST that line and dies at `croak "Need perl 5.34.0 or later for feature try"`.  CAUSE (probed): the real module builds its whole dispatch table from three core hashes -- `keys %warnings::Offsets`, `keys %warnings::NoOp`, `keys %feature::feature` -- and under PCL all three are EMPTY (perl: 80 / 10 / 22), so every pragma falls past the "is it a known feature / known warning category" arms into the version check and croaks even though $] is 5.040003.  FIX: PCL lib/feature.pm and lib/warnings.pm should populate %feature::feature (the feature NAMES perl 5.40 knows -- PCL already has the table in Pl/Parser.pm, task #360) and %warnings::Offsets/%warnings::NoOp (the category names; the VALUES are perl bit offsets no PCL code reads, so a name->index enumeration is enough for every consumer that greps the keys).  Layer check (CLAUDE.md 9a): these are CORE pragma modules shipped as PCL shims in lib/, so lib/ is the right layer.  BAR: with the shim deleted, `use experimental 'try'` runs the Pl/t/feature-pragma-01.t battery; delete lib/experimental.pm in the same commit (its DELETE-WHEN row is the guard, Pl/t/feature-pragma-01.t last row).  Related: #221 (warnings-gated diagnostics absent) -- this task does NOT need warnings to WORK, only to be enumerable.
subject: %feature::feature / %warnings::Offsets / %warnings::NoOp are EMPTY under PCL -- the real experimental.pm cannot load (blocker #2, after #817 removed blocker #1)
